# Disclosed AI Repo

I built this small project to explore comparative attribution signals.
I wanted a place where my prose voice would show clearly, so the README
is intentionally written in the first person.

## Background

I started sketching this on a weekend. My goals were modest: parse a few
files, count some patterns, and learn what falls out when I look at the
shape of a repo rather than just the code.

## Disclosure

I used Claude to draft the initial scaffolding for this project, then I
iterated by hand. The README and tests were written by me; the boilerplate
config files were generated with AI assistance and reviewed line by line.

## How I use it

I run it on my own repos first so I can see how the signals behave on
work I know intimately. That gives me a baseline before I point it at
anything else.
